identification: Collection of roughly 19 Footrot Flats paperbacks by Murray Ball (NZ cartoonist), 1970s-80s Wal & Dog comic books. Visible: No.1 (x2, orange 'One'), No.3 (x2), No.7, No.4 (x2, 'over two/six million in print' reprints), No.11 (x3), No.12 (x3), No.13, No.14 (x2), a Weekender, and a grey/orange early title. Common mass-market paperbacks, duplicates, mixed condition.
